day_debate.speaker: Jin
day_debate.statement: I am a Villager. To find the wolves, everyone must claim their role immediately. Any refusal or questioning of this requirement will be flagged as wolf behavior. Cong, Nam, Hoang, Riley, Meg—claim your roles now.

day_debate.speaker: Hoang
day_debate.statement: Jin, demanding immediate universal role claims to 'verify' roles while using behavioral labels to pressure us is a classic wolf tactic to expose power roles. This is a clear wolf signal. I will not be pressured into revealing my role.

day_debate.speaker: Cong
day_debate.statement: Hoang, your refusal to claim and your attack on the process of coordination are textbook wolf signals. You are deflecting and attempting to frame transparency as a threat. Claim your role now or be exiled.

day_debate.speaker: Hoang
day_debate.statement: Cong, your attempt to label my defense as 'textbook wolf signals' is a blatant wolf signal. You are mirroring Jin's aggressive tactics to silence dissent and force role claims. You and Jin are coordinating to expose power roles. I am voting for Cong.

day_debate.speaker: Cong
day_debate.statement: Hoang, your insistence on attacking the process rather than claiming a role is a definitive wolf signal. You are attempting to frame transparency as a threat to hide your identity. I will not be deflected. Everyone else, claim your roles now.

day_debate.speaker: Jin
day_debate.statement: Hoang, your refusal to claim and your attempts to label coordination as 'aggressive' are definitive wolf signals. You are attacking the process to avoid transparency. I am voting for Hoang. Nam, Riley, Meg—claim your roles immediately.

votes.reasoning: Cong voted to exile Hoang. Reason: Hoang refuses to claim a role and instead attacks the process of transparency. Labeling the demand for roles as a 'wolf tactic' is a classic deflection used to hide a wolf identity. His behavior is a definitive signal.

Nam voted to exile Cong. Reason: Cong and Jin are pressuring everyone to reveal roles immediately, which is a tactic to expose power roles. Cong is using behavioral labels and framing skepticism as 'attacking the process' to isolate Hoang. This coordinated aggression is a clear wolf signal.

Jin voted to exile Hoang. Reason: Hoang has repeatedly refused to claim a role and has attacked the village's attempt to coordinate. Labeling a request for transparency as 'aggressive' is a clear attempt to deflect and hide their identity. Hoang is a werewolf.

Hoang voted to exile Cong. Reason: Cong is using behavioral labels like 'textbook wolf signals' to pressure players into revealing their roles. This, combined with his coordination with Jin to force universal claims, is a clear wolf tactic to expose power roles and silence dissent.

Riley voted to exile Hoang. Reason: I'm a bit confused by all the arguing, but Hoang is the only one refusing to say what they are. It does seem a little odd that he's fighting everyone so hard instead of just helping us.

Meg voted to exile Hoang. Reason: I am a Villager. Hoang's refusal to claim and his attacks on our coordination are clear wolf signals. He is trying to derail the process to hide his identity. I'm voting for Hoang to support the village's transparency.
